accessibility.info:
Up to (3) companions per accessible patron.  Please make every attempt to limit the number of companions in adjacent seating to (1). Place other companions (as possible) in the row just behind the wheelchair space(s). 

Wheelchair seating in Main Hall is available in Row I and (K for extra companion seating) of the Orchestra Level, and Row E and (G for extra companion seating) of the Mezzanine Level. See seating chart for details. Accessible locations are reserved for use by patrons with disabilities, but may be released for general sale when all other locations are sold. If you are planning on transferring to a theater seat from a wheelchair or mobility device, please inform the ticket office when ordering so we may seat you in an appropriate and safe location. Fire safety codes forbid items such as wheelchairs and mobility devices from being left in any aisle where they may become an obstruction in an emergency.

events.name: Too Short Live in Boise!
events.info: ALL AGESDELAYED DELIVERY: There is a ticket delivery delay in place for this event. Tickets will be emailed 48 hours prior to the event. West Coast hip-hop legend Too $hort comes to Knitting Factory in Boise, ID on Friday, October 9, 2026. With a career spanning more than four decades, Too $hort is one of the most influential artists in West Coast hip-hop. Known for classics including , "rdquo" -> Blow the Whistle," , "rdquo" -> The Ghetto," , "rdquo" -> Freaky Tales," , "rdquo" -> Gettin' It," and , "rdquo" -> Get In Where You Fit In," Too $hort has built a legacy that has influenced generations of hip-hop artists and fans. From his early Oakland roots to collaborations with legends including Tupac, The Notorious B.I.G., Snoop Dogg, Jay-Z, E-40, Lil Jon, Scarface, and Pimp C, Too $hort remains one of the defining voices of West Coast rap. He is also a founding member of Mount Westmore, alongside Ice Cube, Snoop Dogg, and E-40. Experience a true West Coast hip-hop pioneer live in Boise! Super Fan GA Ticket: Be the first to enter the venue to get right in front of the stage (30 minutes before general admission doors open)! Be the first to the merch booth without the long lines! (Very Limited Super Fan Tickets Available)

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Box Office Operating Hours: Monday thru Friday: 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM Saturday thru Sunday: CLOSED For events that occur on a Saturday or Sunday, the Box Office will open at 12:00 PM. The ExtraMile Arena Box Office is located on the East side of the Arena, just to the right of Entrance 2 and adjacent to the Albertson's Stadium parking lot.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express. Cash to card machines available.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is located at the Box Office. For events that occur on a weekday, the office will open at 10:00am. For events occurring on Saturday or Sunday, the office will open at 12:00pm *Location* The ExtraMile Arena Box Office is located on the East side of the Arena, just to the right of Entrance 2 and adjacent to the Albertson's Stadium parking lot.

venues.parkingDetail: ExtraMile Arena encourages patrons to allow at least 45 minutes to park and access ExtraMile Arena. Parking is sold in advance for the Arena and Stadium lots. For patrons who did not pre-purchase parking, a parking fee will be collected by an attendant as you enter the parking lots. Depending on the event, parking costs typically range from $15.00 to $25.00. For parking prices for a particular event or to purchase parking, please contact the Box Office at (208) 426-1766. On the day of an event, parking can no longer be purchased prior to arrival. Patrons will need to purchase parking in cash when they arrive on-site for the event. Parking lots open 1 hour before doors.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible Seating is shown on the Interactive Seat Map and can be purchased online. Accessible Seating can also be purchased at the Box Office. The number of accessible seats is limited. Please be respectful of those in need of these seats. Companion seating is limited to 3 per person and will be located as close as possible to the accessible seating, based on availability. For more information and assistance please call (208) 426-1766.

generalInfo.generalRule: All guests entering the Arena may be subject to metal-detector screening, visual inspection, and bag inspection conducted by ExtraMile Arena security personnel. Prohibited items include anything that can be deemed a threat to public safety by ExtraMile Arena and include, but are not limited to, the following: video recording or streaming devices, iPads, selfie sticks, outside food or drink, large bags or backpacks, weapons of any kind including chains, spikes, collars, some jewelry or any implement that could be used as a weapon, fireworks/pyrotechnics of any kind, laser pointers, glow sticks or flashbulbs. Smoking and vaping are not permitted inside the venue.
generalInfo.childRule: All persons entering the venue require a ticket. Children's events may have a unique policy for infants/toddlers; contact the Box Office for ticketing policies for a specific event. Please ask an Usher about our SAFE program which provides wristbands for reuniting individuals that may become separated from their party.

events.pleaseNote: This is Bluey's Big Play, For Real Life. When Dad feels like a little bit of time out, Bluey and Bingo have other plans! Join them as they pull out all of the games and cleverness at their disposal to get Dad off that bean bag. Bluey's Big Play is a theatrical adaptation of the Emmy award-winning children's television series, with an original story by Bluey creator Joe Brumm, and new music by Bluey composer, Joff Bush. Join the Heelers in their live theatre show made just for you, featuring brilliantly created puppets, this is Bluey as you've never seen it before, brought to real life. Bluey's Big Play is presented by BBC Studios and Andew Kay in association with Windmill Theatre Co. Webstie: blueylive.com Facebook/Instagram: @OfficialBlueyTV #BlueysBigPlay Doors open at 5:00 PM Approximate run of show: 50 minutes with no intermission VIP (P1) ticket packages are available online only. VIP event is POST show.
